title: Camp Wannakumbac

services.name: 2026 Summer Camp
services.desc: Online Registration for the Summer Camp 2026 is Now Open - Secure Your Spot Today! Wannakumbac's Summer Camp program provides a 7- day, 6-night co-ed experience for campers (ages 8 to 15). Camp has provided a creative, educational, and unique social experience for young people from all backgrounds and cultures from across Manitoba and beyond for over 75 years. For youth (Ages 16+), we have offered Counsellor In Training Leadership Development programs for almost 30 years! Wannakumbac is a non-denominational camp, owned by The Clear Lake Community Service Cooperative Inc. Est. 2024, which is non-profit, and ensures that camper fees are lowest possible.
